tbl_description: One row per Niskin bottle (position, depth, time, cast and bottle number), CalCOFI cruises 2002-2023. Bottles with a conflicting depth or with values crossed between QC flags are held out (Q01, Q02).
HPLC pigment concentrations in ug/L, long format (one row per analysis x pigment type; a replicate bottle has two analyses). measurement_qual is the provider QC flag (0-3).
